title: Core, Services, and Plugins product language
summary: User-facing product language now presents MyAPES Core as the platform, Services as the APES CIC / Shelter / Pet Care hubs, and Plugins as Tickets, Cases, Pet Profiles, and Consultations. Runtime keys, routes, and permission names are unchanged.
changes: Renamed signed-in chrome, Admin, changelog, and APP_NAME branding to MyAPES Core while keeping login and registration as MyAPES Account.
Relabelled Super Admin Modules navigation and registry copy to Plugins, and sub-core wording to Services.
Updated hub empty and summary headings, tips, permission titles, and flash messages to Plugins and Services language.
Documented the Core → Services → Plugins vocabulary in README and PRODUCT.md.
version_rationale: Minor: backward-compatible product language and documentation capability with no API, permission-key, or data-model break.
validation: Focused PHPUnit suites for branding, maintenance, OIDC maintenance page, module administration/navigation, hub provider contracts, changelog page, and changelog prepare command all passed.
php artisan myapes:changelog-validate --base-ref=origin/main after filling release notes.
known_limitations: Internal class names, database tables, permission keys (admin.modules.*), URLs, and CLI commands still use module and sub-core identifiers.
Published historical release notes keep earlier Modules and MyAPES Account wording.
rollback: Redeploy the previous application version. No database migration accompanies this release; label-only rollback restores prior copy.
provenance: Defined by the Core, Services, and Plugins product language work for MyAPES Account issue #89 and pull request #90.
